comment: The WEIGHT knobs are concentric with the TUNE SELECT knobs and sit at the same centres, params 6 to 8 over params 3 to 5; the outer ring of the larger knob is still clickable, so both are tagged. The six PAUSE SELECT switches and the six register buttons are numbered right to left, param 9 and param 15 being the rightmost. The panel letters pair a stage with its complement, A with G, B with H and so on to F with M. The output jack is param-free but numbered second: output 1 is the upper jack, marked OUT, and output 0 the lower, marked GATE.
